how_to_use.coping: sit on COPING_BEARING_Z but read clad_top_edge_z(elev, s): the as-built top edge moves +-2.4 mm and a coping laid to a flat 10.340 will rock
how_to_use.signage: use sign_fix_grid(); every point misses a joint by >= 40 mm and lands on a panel with a bonded backing plate
how_to_use.standoff: DO NOT MOUNT FLUSH TO clad_x_e / clad_y_s. Those are the SET-OUT planes; the as-built face runs up to face_clearance(elev) = 15.0 mm proud of them on the east (14.5 south, 3.6 on the corner) once fabrication offset, installed tilt and oil-canning are added. Stand off by as_built.face_proud_max, or query the panel you land on.
how_to_use.rainwater: the pipe runs in a RECESSED COLUMN already built; fix to rwp_bracket_points(), which are on the carrier rails, never into a cassette
how_to_use.material: mat_anodised() reads 15 vertex attributes; call bake_panel_attrs() on anything emitted into it
